data.description:
# Show Card Position Outlines in HandView

## Problem Statement

Players have no visual indication of their hand capacity — they cannot see how many additional cards they can hold. Placing light card-position outlines in empty slots solves this.

## Users

- **Player** (Main Street, Golf, etc.) — sees empty hand slots as ghost outlines, knows instantly how many more cards they can buy/hold.
- **Developer** — enables outlines via a single boolean option on HandView construction; no scene-level wiring required.

## Acceptance Criteria

- HandView renders a semi-transparent card-sized rectangle at every position up to `maxSlots`, including occupied positions (ghost outlines behind real cards).
- Outlines are enabled via a new `HandViewOptions.showPositionOutlines: boolean` flag (default `false`).
- Outline rendering respects `reducedMotion` (no animation changes — outlines are static).
- Outlines update correctly on every hand mutation: `setCards()`, `addCard()`, `removeCard()`, `sortCards()` (animated path), and layout changes (`setSpacing()`, `setArcRadius()`, `setLayoutDirection()`, `setBaseX()`, `setBaseY()`).
- Outlines are destroyed on `HandView.destroy()` with no orphaned display objects.
- Unit tests verify outline creation, update, and destruction; a browser test in `GymHandPileScene` verifies visual correctness.

## Constraints

- **Visual style:** Stroke-only (no fill), 2px stroke width, colour `0x666666` at `0.5` alpha, shape `CARD_W x CARD_H` rectangle centred on the card position.
- **When to show:** Always — outlines appear at every slot up to `maxSlots`, including occupied positions (rendered behind real cards).
- **API:** Two new `HandViewOptions` fields: `showPositionOutlines: boolean` (default `false`), `maxSlots: number` (optional — total slots to outline). If `maxSlots` is omitted and `showPositionOutlines` is `true`, outlines render one per current card (matching the occupied-position-only mode).
- **Depth:** Outlines render at depth `index - 0.5` so they sit **behind** card sprites (depth `index`) but above any background elements. If Phaser depth sorting proves unreliable, use a dedicated render group.
- **Layout direction:** Outlines must handle both `'horizontal'` and `'vertical'` layout directions.

## Existing State

- `HandView` (`src/ui/HandView.ts`) manages card sprite creation, layout (`layoutCardPositions`), selection, drag-and-drop, and event emission.
- No outline or ghost-rendering code exists in HandView or related UI modules.
- Game state already tracks hand capacity (e.g., `maxHandSize` in Main Street) — outlines would simply visualise the gap between current hand count and capacity.

## Desired Change

- Add `showPositionOutlines` and `maxSlots` to `HandViewOptions`.
- Add `private outlineRects: Phaser.GameObjects.Rectangle[]` field.
- In `rebuildDisplay()`, after creating card sprites, create outline rectangles for positions `0..maxSlots-1` (or `0..cards.length-1` if `maxSlots` is not set).
- In `applyLayout()`, reposition outline rectangles to match the new card positions.
- In `destroy()`, call `outlineRects.forEach(r => r.destroy())` and clear the array.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `src/ui/HandView.ts` — Add `showPositionOutlines`, `maxSlots`, outline rendering, layout updates, destruction
- `src/ui/constants.ts` — No changes needed (uses existing `CARD_W`/`CARD_H`)
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymHandPileScene.ts` — Add a slider/button to toggle outline preview
- `tests/ui/HandView.outlines.test.ts` — Unit tests for outline lifecycle

## Related Work

- `CG-0MS937FT9006273E` — Gym Hand & Pile: selection highlight renders over cards to the right (completed; depth ordering reference)
- `GymHandPileScene` — canonical Gym scene for HandView testing

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Scope creep:** Outlines are strictly visual — no click interaction, no animation. Animated entrance effects are a follow-up.
- **Assumption:** Phaser depth sorting at `index - 0.5` places outlines reliably behind card sprites. Verified against CG-0MS937FT9006273E pattern.
- **Vertical cascade:** Outline positions must cascade vertically matching card positions — layout code handles both directions.
- **Empty hand:** With 0 cards and `maxSlots=5`, 5 outlines render (useful for showing the full capacity of an empty hand).

## Clarifying Questions & Answers

- Q: "What should the card-position outlines look like?" — Answer (producer): As proposed — stroke-only, 2px width, colour `0x666666` at `0.5` alpha, card-sized rectangles.
- Q: "When to show?" — Answer (producer): (A) Always — all positions including occupied ones, as ghost outlines behind existing cards.
- Q: "Configuration API?" — Answer (producer): "Whatever you think" → per-instance `HandViewOptions` boolean flag (default `false`).
